defective_pattern: Inserting a blank newline in Markdown or an empty paragraph (doc.add_paragraph()) between a table and its explanatory note (*یادداشت.*).
why_defective: Detaches the table note from the table entity, causing improper pagination splits and violating APA 7 formatting guidelines.
observed_symptoms: Empty line between table closing pipe | and *یادداشت
Blank paragraph between Word table and note paragraph
corrective_remedy: Place *یادداشت immediately on the next line without an empty line in Markdown. In DOCX generation, attach the note paragraph directly with tight space_before (0-2 pt) and no intervening empty paragraph.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of a blank/empty paragraph or \n\n sequence immediately preceding a table note.
